title: ZARIITHEDON - Soakin
htmlContent:
ZARIITHEDON is nothing short of amazing on his raw energy banger “Soakin”. The production is hard and exhilarating while ZARIITHEDON provides all the excitement in the world, with his infectious flow that engages you from the second he opens his mouth till the track ends. The lyrics are swagger filled and have that bravado you look for in Hip Hop music.
